name: Ano, Subarashii  o Mou Ichido
original_name: あの、素晴らしい　　をもう一度
source:
"Even without my memories, I won't be scared.  As long as you're there to remember for me."
So said the girl with 『no future』.
If a future is made by repetition, stacking up the days, then indeed a 『future』 she lacked.
『Anterograde amnesia』.
Also known as 『repeating disease』, a curse that eats away at your memories and future as they form.
"If someone makes a mistake, they correct it.  Not just repeat it over and over...  No one should be forced into doing that."
So said the man with 『no past』.
And thus the two set out to recover the 『past』 and 『future』 that they respectively lack.
All the while not realizing they've already entered the 『repeating world』...

[Translated from [url=http://www.anos.jp/anos1/anos1.htm]The Official site[/url]]
translation:
“就算没有记忆，我也不会害怕，只要你在，替我记住。”
“没有未来”的少女如此说道。
如果未来是通过重复、日积月累而形成的，那么她确实缺少一个‘未来’。
“顺行性遗忘症”。
也被称为“重复疾病”，一种会吞噬你形成的记忆和未来的诅咒。
“如果有人犯了错误，他们会纠正它。而不仅仅是一遍又一遍地重复……任何人都不应该被迫这样做。”
那个“没有过去”的男人如此说道。
两人就这样出发去寻找各自所缺失的‘过去’和‘未来’。
却不知自己已经进入了‘重复世界’……

[译自[url=http://www.anos.jp/anos1/anos1.htm]官方网站[/url]]
